profile.ja: 主に前線での戦闘任務にあたる対魔忍。任務以外ではボーッとしていて、訓練などでも目立つことはない。だが、いざ戦闘となると忍法の特性を生かし、驚くほど執念深い戦いを見せる。そのギャップと口下手な性格からか、親しく付き合う友人などもおらず、基本的には一人で居る事が多い。ただ、本人は決して人嫌いなわけではなく、仲間意識も強いタイプで、仲間を傷つける者には一切の容赦を見せない。普段は非常に質素な生活を送り、趣味もこれといってないが、餌付けした野鳥と戯れるのを日課としている。前回の装備更新をした後、妙に機嫌が良くなった翡翠は、さらに装備を新しくしたいと要望を出した。積極的な姿に周囲は驚きつつも、新たに長期任務用の装備が製作されることに。対魔忍スーツの雰囲気は変わり、武器の錫杖も分割が可能なものになった。新装備自体には嬉しそうな表情を浮かべた翡翠だったが、同時にテストとして長期任務が言い渡されるとわずかに不満げな顔を浮かべる。ただ、その変化はよほど仲が良い者しか気づくことはないのだった。
profile.en: Yuri Hisui is a Taimanin primarily assigned to frontline combat missions. Outside of missions she zones out and never stands out even during training. However, when battle begins she leverages the unique traits of her ninjutsu and fights with astonishing tenacity. Because of that gap and her poor social skills, she has no close friends and usually spends time alone. She isn't anti-social at all, though—she has a strong sense of camaraderie and shows no mercy to anyone who harms her comrades. She leads a very modest lifestyle with no particular hobbies, but she makes it a daily habit to play with the wild birds she feeds. After the last equipment upgrade, her mood inexplicably brightened, and she requested even newer gear. While everyone was surprised by her proactive attitude, new long-term mission equipment was approved. The Taimanin suit's look changed, and the tin staff weapon became modular. She wore a pleased expression at the new gear, though she showed a slight hint of displeasure when told the upcoming long-term mission was a test. Only those close to her would even notice the change.

text.ja: じゃじゃーん、また新装備になったよ。今度のは長期任務用装備。ジャケットがかっこいい
text.en: Ta-da! I've got new gear again. This one's for long-term missions. The jacket looks awesome.

text.ja: 折角の装備だけど、長期任務に行っちゃうと君に会えない時間が増えるのは寂しい
text.en: It's a great outfit, but if I'm off on a long-term mission, I'll be missing you more often… that makes me sad.

text.ja: 今回の武器は短いのが二本……と見せかけてこう、合・体！　これで今まで通りにも戦える
text.en: This weapon looks like two short sticks… but watch—combine! Now I can fight just like before.

text.ja: 今はジャケットを着てるけど、暑くなったら脱げるから、季節を跨ぐ任務もバッチリ。君はどっちの方が好き？
text.en: I'm wearing the jacket now, but I can take it off when it gets hot, so I'm ready for missions that span seasons. Which look do you prefer?

text.ja: ん？　そんなにジッと見てどうしたの？　おっぱいが今にも零れちゃいそう……？　エッチ♪
text.en: Huh? Why are you staring so intently? My chest feels like it's about to burst…? Naughty.

text.ja: 私が長期任務に行ってる間、寂しがって泣いちゃダメだよ？　え？　そんな事しない？　むー、ちょっとは泣いてもいいよ？
text.en: Don't go crying because I'm away on a long-term mission, okay? Huh? You wouldn't do that? Hmm, it's fine if you shed a few tears.

text.ja: 長期任務だと一緒にいられない……と思ったけど、二人で任務に就けばずっと一緒にいられる。ナイスアイデア
text.en: I thought a long-term mission meant we'd be apart, but if we take on the mission together, we can stay side by side the whole time. Nice idea.

text.ja: なんか、色々と新しいメカとかも貰ったけどよく分からない……でも、多分便利……なんだと思う
text.en: I got a bunch of new gear and gadgets, but I don't really get them… Still, they're probably useful… I think.

text.ja: フー、フー……ずっと君とエッチ出来なかったから、もう我慢なんて無理。今すぐいっぱいしよ
text.en: Hoo, hoo… I haven't been able to be intimate with you forever, I can't hold back any longer. Let's do a lot right now.

text.en: My teased pussy can't stop leaking naughty juices…♪ For the time we didn't meet, keep going until you've cum all of it, okay?

text.ja: 任務の間ずっと君のチンポの事ばっかり考えちゃってたんだ♪　ふふ、君ももうカチカチ♪　どれだけ出来るか楽しみ♪
text.en: I've been thinking about your dick the whole mission…♪ Hehe, yours is already rock-hard♪ I'm looking forward to seeing how much you can do♪
